Arriving in New York: A City Timelapse

Andy CASA, UCL East

The majority of city timelapse movies we have featured are captured from a fixed point. Of course if you are on board a ship and heading into one of the most vibrant cityscapes in the world you can go one step further:

Arriving to NY (Enhanced) from H. Caesar on Vimeo.
 
The movie was created by H. Caesar over on Vimeo.
